description: This file declares the SandboxManager class and related components for managing sandboxed processes within the cuttlefish::process_sandboxer namespace. It includes method declarations for creating, running, and managing sandboxed processes, as well as handling events and client communication.

classes.name: SandboxManager
classes.description: Manages sandboxed processes, including creation, execution, event handling, and client communication within the sandbox environment.

classes.name: ManagedProcess
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a managed process, either sandboxed or not, with methods to retrieve client file descriptor, poll file descriptor, and exit code.

classes.name: ProcessNoSandbox
classes.description: Represents a process that runs without sandbox restrictions.

classes.name: SandboxedProcess
classes.description: Represents a sandboxed process managed by SandboxManager.

classes.name: SocketClient
classes.description: Handles client socket communication for sandboxed processes.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new SandboxManager instance with specified host information.

methods.name: RunProcess
methods.description: Starts a process with given arguments, environment, and file descriptors.

methods.name: Iterate
methods.description: Processes events such as client messages, process exits, and signals.

methods.name: Running
methods.description: Returns whether the sandbox manager is currently running.
